name: Menden Backend
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '**'
  push:
    branches:
      - 'main'
    tags-ignore:
      - '**'

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  backend:
    uses: sw-code/urbo-app-template/.github/workflows/reusable-backend-workflow.yml@c19d2f64bf26344a9bacf84b2348dbe094696767
    secrets: inherit
    with:
      appName: menden-backend
      repoName: menden-erlebnis-stadt
      workingDirectory: backend
      # JDK 25 migration: build/test on JDK 25.
      javaVersion: "25"
      deploymentName: menden-backend
      deploymentNamespace: menden
      publishMavenArtifacts: true
      changesPathsFilter: |
        backend:
          - 'backend/**'
          - '.github/workflows/backend.yml'

observation.command: cd /workspace && ls .github/workflows/ && grep -rn "java-version\|distribution\|JAVA" .github/workflows/backend*.yml app*.* 2>/dev/null; cat .github/workflows/backend.yml 2>/dev/null | head -60
